CASE 01 / SECURITY, DATA AND QUALITY

01

Sàbat Lligats Metàl·lics, S.L.

Each line, its own environment.
All connected to the business.

Sàbat runs its company infrastructure in the cloud, but production does not depend on it. As a security measure, five production lines and one shear work protected by IoT Gateway NG, each in its own isolated environment.

  • 5 + 1production lines and one shear protected
  • 6fully isolated working environments
  • Real timecontextualised data to the MES and the ERP
  • AIimage-based quality control on two lines

Telemetry from each line, processed and contextualised, sent to the MES and the ERP in real time.

COMPANY CLOUD

Each line and the shear have their own gateway and their own isolated environment. If the cloud does not respond, they keep working.

01 / THE CHALLENGE

Cloud, yes. Dependence, no.

All the company’s infrastructure is in the cloud. Production, however, cannot stop if the connection fails, nor share risks between lines.

02 / THE SOLUTION

One gateway per line.

Each IoT Gateway NG creates an isolated working environment. It collects the line’s telemetry, processes it at the plant and feeds it to the MES and the ERP fully contextualised, in real time.

03 / THE RESULT

Security and useful data.

  • Lines that do not depend on cloud servers to run.
  • MES and ERP fed with contextualised data, instantly.
  • Performance metrics such as MTTR and other indicators, calculated in real time.
✓ QUALITY OK
AI · COMPUTER VISION

AI inspects every part.
Right at the line.

On two of the lines, the gateways also capture photos of the robots in operation. An AI image-recognition model analyses them on the gateway itself and makes decisions on the quality of the finished product, in real time.

  • Images taken while the robots operate
  • AI image recognition, run at the plant
  • Quality decision on the finished product
